Kolkata Metro Tunnel Boring Machine Completes Victoria Station Breakthrough

The Tunnel Boring Machine (TBM) named Durga has successfully broken through at the Victoria Metro station in Kolkata. This milestone marks a significant advancement for the city's metro expansion project. Railway workers reportedly celebrated the achievement, which follows a year of tunneling work on the Purple Line.
